stemMd: A report describes how a library chose books for a multilingual shelf. The writer wants to emphasize community participation. Which sentence should be added?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The books arrived in twelve cardboard boxes.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Residents submitted suggestions in six languages at two open planning meetings.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The shelving units have adjustable brackets.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The library closes at eight on Thursdays.

explanationMd: Look for evidence of residents actively influencing the project. Suggestions submitted at open meetings directly demonstrate participation in book selection.

distractorRationale.d: Closing time does not establish participation in choosing books.
distractorRationale.a: Delivery packaging does not explain who helped select titles.
distractorRationale.c: Shelf construction does not show community participation in selection.
